correctness.rationale: Exact decomposition by zero gaps gives H3=z^(b+c+3)F_aF_d and H2=z^(b+2)F_aF_c+z^(c+2)F_bF_d. Valuations, degree and peak recover the unordered outer and inner pairs; candidate orientation differences factor as (F_a-F_d)(z^(b+2)F_c-z^(c+2)F_b), nonzero whenever both pairs are distinct. Equal-pair degeneracies coincide with reversal or identical words. The weight-two/one cases follow from single geometric products. A 4096-gap symbolic-to-direct check and 7315-word exact decoder check ran successfully. The weight-four boundary pair was checked independently and attributed to earlier work. No finite check substitutes for the polynomial-domain proof.

value.rationale: The theorem reduces a natural noiseless sequencing readout from all substring composition types to just the two highest one-count layers, uniformly at all lengths for three-sparse words. Gap-polynomial inversion offers a direct decoder and structural understanding of the sharp full-spectrum four-one obstruction. The reduction is a natural information/reconstruction threshold, not a finite census or routine case of a length-only condition. Its scope is not claimed optimal in the number of retained top layers.
